basic_details.short_information: The Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) has officially announced the Part Time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.bhel.com. Candidates not exceeding 65 years of age and holding an MBBS degree along with an MD/DNB in Medicine, Internal Medicine, Respiratory Medicine, Chest & TB, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Physiology, or Pharmacology are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 19 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and walk-in details are shared below.

age_limit.details: Maximum age for Part Time Medical Consultant is 65 years as on 01 August 2026. Age can be relaxed up to 70 years with specific approval of the management.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS with MD/ DNB in Medicine/Internal Medicine/ Respiratory Medicine/Chest & TB/Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Physiology/ Pharmacology
qualification.details: Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist): MBBS having specialisation in any one of MD/DNB- Medicine/ Internal Medicine/ Respiratory Medicine/ Chest & TB/ Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Physiology/ Pharmacology.

salary_details.details: Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist): Rs. 800/- per hour

selection_process: Walk-in Interview Document Verification Personal Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for BHEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for BHEL Recruitment 2026 is Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist). This role is open for eligible medical professionals looking for contractual engagement.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) post in the BHEL recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) post is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) post is 65 years as on 01 August 2026. Age relaxation up to 70 years may be considered with management approval.

faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) position at BHEL?
faq.answer: The salary for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) position is Rs. 800 per hour. This is a contractual role with remuneration based on hours worked.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBBS degree with MD/DNB in Medicine/Internal Medicine/Respiratory Medicine/Chest & TB/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Physiology/Pharmacology to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview, followed by Document Verification, and a Personal Interview. Candidates must clear all stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview for BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant (Specialist) be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue details and reporting time.

faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational, experience, category certificates), a duly filled application form (if required), and extra passport-size photographs.
